title: The Day of the Ridiculous Invention
skyStory: The moon has bounced into Aquarius, a third lit and buzzing with gadgets. Aquarius moons are the mad scientists of the zodiac: wild hair, a lab coat with pockets full of springs, ideas nobody asked for. First quarter means a little push. Today, the push is sideways, and it comes with blueprints drawn on a napkin.

reading: Your brain has been waiting for an Aquarius moon all month. Something annoying at home or at work will suddenly reveal its fix to you, and the fix will be both brilliant and slightly absurd, like using a clothes peg as a cable organiser or a muffin tin as a desk tray.

Build it. Do not improve it, do not plan version two, do not start a spreadsheet of related fixes. The [[Knight of Wands]] says one invention, and the Tiger should be extremely proud of exactly one invention. Around 4:30 pm, show it to someone like it is a museum piece. Accept their compliments without explaining how it could be better.
joel.mission: Rename one ordinary object in the house with a grand inventor's name and use only that name until bedtime.
joel.omen: A string of lights with exactly one bulb out. Perfection is overrated; the rest are shining fine.

reading: The Rat is an inventor by nature, the clever one who notices the latch that does not quite catch. Today you will fix something in about four seconds that has bothered someone else for months. They will look at you like you performed a magic trick.

Let them. Do not say it was easy. Say 'yes, I am remarkable', or at least think it very loudly. Aquarius loves a genius who does not apologise. In the evening, tell the story of the fix with full hand gestures, including a dramatic pause right before the click. The pause is the whole performance.
nancy.mission: Draw a terrible blueprint for a machine that does one silly chore, like sorting socks by mood, and label every part.
nancy.omen: A squirrel outwitting a bird feeder. Clever creatures always find a way, and today you are one of them.

together.text: Invent a ridiculous gadget together over messages. Joel names it, Nancy names its secret feature, Joel adds a warning label, Nancy writes the slogan. Stop after four rounds. Saturn will pretend not to read it and secretly want one.

game.intro: Inventors, put down your soldering irons. Tonight we count tiny coloured squares and nobody goes over.
game.question: A standard 3x3 twisty puzzle cube has how many coloured stickers in total?
